text:
Alejandra: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off an Integrator Track + Skill Guild for SI partners. Goal: certify 3 SIs and 2 hardware integrators in cohort 1. Need alignment on labs, playbooks, and joint announcement timing.
Devin: Great. timeline?
Mira: Proposed cohort start May 12 (6 weeks). Format: 2x live workshops, weekly lab exercises, self-paced modules, final practical cert.
Samir: Lab infra question — who can provision partner sandboxes (VPC + GPUs)? cc @Luca
Luca: I can stand up a shared Dedicated sandbox for the cohort. Need partner list + expected parallel sessions. I'll also prepare a VPC peering template and IAM role snippets.
Alejandra: I'll collect partner roster by EOD. Initial targets: Nodo Systems, BlueLayer, Atlas Integrations (pending legal).
Devin: Curriculum draft: 1) onboarding & infra (VPC, peering, keys) 2) serving runtime & model variants 3) quantization & cost controls 4) rollout strategies + regressions 5) marketplace listing + billing flows.
Mira: Certification rules: practical lab (deploy a model variant to Dedicated), smoke tests, run a short perf script (1k tokens at target p95), plus short demo call. Pass/fail rubric will be public.
Samir: Add a fault-injection lab: node drain + fallback to hosted model, validate graceful degradation. That should be a required test.
Alejandra: Yes — resilience is a must. Also thinking of a "partner trainer kit" (slides, terraform snippets, runbook, recorded demos).
Devin: On the announcements side — we should align PR/comms to follow cohort completion by ~2 weeks. Need legal check and a partner quote.
partner-bot: PR template and NDA checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/pr-templates/si-launch (internal)
Mira: I'll create the trainer repo and TOC. Planning to include: Syllabus, Lab steps, Test harness, Badge artifacts, and Troubleshooting guide.
Samir: Hardware partner ask: BlueLayer offered access to an A100 pool for a tuning session — can we slot that into week 3 for quantization tuning?
Luca: Dedicated sandbox currently can allocate 4xA100. I can carve out 24h windows per partner and add calendar slots. Will add cert bot hooks for verifying infra post-deploy.
Alejandra: Action items: Mira -> repo + trainer materials by 2026-04-15; Luca -> sandbox + VPC peering templates by 2026-04-10; Devin -> PR & partner comms draft by 2026-04-20; Samir -> test cases + fault-injection playbook by 2026-04-12. I'll start partner outreach and confirm dates.
Devin: +1 to dates. Suggest a dry-run with internal integrators 1 week before cohort.
Mira: Good call. I'll schedule an internal pilot session.
Alejandra: Let's meet Tue 11am PT next week to finalize syllabus and timeline.
Devin: I'll send the invite and agenda.
Mira: Added Zoom + agenda.
Alejandra: Thanks team! :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for trainer repo passed (build #482) :white_check_mark:
